LESSON: PAINTING MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2.1: Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What do you use for painting?
